aid.value: For 2026–27, East-West University says international students may receive an institutional scholarship of up to 30% of tuition. Its listed international tuition and fees are $8,465 per quarter. This is not a full-need or full-cost commitment; the international admissions page separately requires proof of funds for F-1 students.

attributes.aidShort: International scholarship up to 30% of tuition; no full-cost promise

evidence.quote: International Students are eligible to receive an institutional scholarship of up to 30% of tuition.

testing.value: The general admissions requirements label SAT/ACT as recommended, but the same page's mandatory-document checklist lists ACT or SAT results. Do not infer a test-optional policy until admissions resolves this contradiction. English and math placement tests are separate.

english.value: For first-year international applicants, TOEFL is recommended but explicitly not required; all incoming students take East-West's English and math placement tests. International transfer applicants must demonstrate English proficiency if applicable, using an accepted TOEFL, IELTS, Pearson, SAT/ACT, Duolingo score or qualifying U.S. English-composition coursework. The first-year policy must not be applied to transfers.

evidence.quote: The TOEFL is not required for admissions at East-West University.

fee.value: The published international-admissions instructions require a non-refundable $300 USD application processing fee for applicants from abroad. East-West's tuition page distinguishes this from the $40 admission fee for domestic applicants and foreign students already residing in the United States. Applicants should confirm which category applies before paying; the SEVIS charge is separate.

evidence.quote: International applicants are required to pay a nonrefundable $300 USD application processing fee.

deadline.value: East-West University states that it accepts admissions and enrollment on a rolling basis in each Fall, Winter and Spring quarter. No single fixed 2026–27 application deadline is published on the international-admissions page; applicants needing an F-1 visa should confirm timing with admissions well before their intended quarter.

evidence.quote: We accept admissions and enrollments on a rolling basis every quarter.
